title: Nanoparticle jetting 3D printing of zirconia: Optimized intaglio microstructures for achieving superior bonding performance and fracture resistance in fixed prosthodontics
html: Ultrathin 3-dimensionally (3D) printed zirconia restorations require optimized intaglio microstructures to balance bonding performance and fracture resistance; however, systematic data regarding surface morphology and depth for nanoparticle jetting (NPJ)-fabricated zirconia are lacking.
